tools.full_reset_warning:
The following actions will be performed:
• Stop the listener, converter, and answering processes
• Remove sign-in startup entries and desktop/startup shortcuts
• Clear the DeepSeek API key and Aliyun TTS credentials
• Restore default answering settings and clear interface preferences
• Delete virtual microphone WAV files, temporary TTS files, and assistant logs

The following will be kept: exam packs, answer history, and answer records.
